name: Dai-ichi Hotel Tokyo
accessSummary: Shimbashi Station (JR / Tokyo Metro Ginza Line): about 2 min walk (directly connected via the Uchisaiwaicho underground walkway) / Shimbashi Station (Toei Asakusa Line / Yurikamome): about 5 min walk / Uchisaiwaicho Station (Toei Mita Line): about 3 min walk / Shiodome Station (Toei Oedo Line): about 10 min walk

rooms.name: La Rose (5F)
rooms.note: Can be divided into 2 (I and II). When divided, each part is 291㎡ with a 7.2 m ceiling: theater 260 / classroom 162 / standing buffet 200 / seated dinner 140. Seated buffet: 260 for the whole room, 110 when divided

rooms.name: Primavera (4F)
rooms.note: Can be divided into 2 (I and II) by a movable wall. When divided, each part is 240㎡ with a 3.4 m ceiling: theater 200 / classroom 126 / standing buffet 120 / seated dinner 110. Seated buffet: 200 for the whole room, 80 when divided

rooms.name: Lumiere (21F)
rooms.note: Banquet hall on the top floor. Seated buffet: 64. Foyer and anteroom available

rooms.name: Flora (4F)
rooms.note: Can be divided into 2 (E and W). When divided, each part is 60㎡ with a 2.9 m ceiling: theater 50 / classroom 24 / standing 25 / seated dinner 20

rooms.name: Cosmos / Cyclamen / Cattleya (4F)
rooms.note: All 3 rooms are the same size (60㎡ each). The capacities in the table are per room

rooms.name: Margaret (4F)
rooms.note: The official table gives capacities for banquet and party use only (seated dinner 25 / standing 40)

ops.parking: The hotel's underground parking lot (Times Dai-ichi Hotel Tokyo) has 74 spaces (including contract vehicles). The rate is 2,200 yen per night (tax included), with 2 hours free for restaurant use of 3,000 yen or more. Advance reservations are not accepted; if the lot is full, use a nearby paid parking lot. A parking lot in a neighboring building (Times Shinkobashi Building) is also listed.
ops.restaurants: The hotel has restaurants. On B1F: World Buffet L'ETOILE, Yakitori Restaurant ISEHIRO, Unagi Restaurant KANDA KIKUKAWA and ISSEKI SANCHO. On 2F: French Restaurant ENCHANTÉ, Japanese Restaurant AKASHI, Café Bar TRAX and Chinese restaurant BANKODEN. On 21F: Teppan-yaki Restaurant ITTETSU. On 1F: Patisserie RUE DES BRIQUES and the LOBBY LOUNGE.
